name: shear_capacity
description: Nominal and design shear capacity of a rectangular beam. Simplified Vc (Eq. 22.5.5.1(a)) unless A_s, V_u and M_u are all given, then detailed Vc (Eq. 22.5.5.1(b)) capped at 0.29·λ·sqrt(f'c)·b·d. Stirrup contribution Vs = A_v·f_yw·d/s (Eq. 22.5.8.5.3) applies when A_v, s and f_yw are all > 0. λ = 1.0 normal-weight. Returns V_c_kN, V_s_kN, V_n_kN, phiV_n_kN, phi_v.

A_v.description: Total stirrup area, usually 2 × one leg (mm²)

A_s.description: Longitudinal tension steel area (mm²); with V_u/M_u switches to detailed Vc

V_u.description: Factored shear at critical section (kN); with A_s/M_u switches to detailed Vc

M_u.description: Factored moment at critical section (kN·m); must be > 0 for detailed Vc

output.basis: ACI 318M-19 §22.5.5.1(a)/(b) + §22.5.8.5.3, φ=0.75 (§21.2.1); Eq(c) size-effect not implemented
